products.title: Bristol Zest – Eau de Parfum, 50 ml
products.short_description: A bright, sparkling citrus fragrance with white flowers and a clean musky finish.
products.description:
Bristol Zest is a fresh, uplifting Eau de Parfum built around zesty lemon and bergamot. The citrus opening settles into soft white flowers and finishes with a clean, light musk that stays close to the skin. Fragrance made in France.

**Size:** 50 ml

**Concentration:** Eau de Parfum

**Best for:** daytime, office, summer and everyday wear. A light, easy fragrance for both men and women.

details.title: How to use
details.body: Hold the bottle upright and spray on the body or clothing from 15–20 cm away. For best results, apply to pulse points – wrists, neck and behind the ears. Do not rub.

details.title: Caution and storage
details.body: Highly flammable. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Keep away from heat, sparks and open flames. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Keep out of reach of children.

details.title: Ingredients
details.body: Alcohol Denat, Fragrance (Parfum), Limonene, Linalool, Citronellol, Geraniol, Coumarin, Eugenol, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone.

details.title: Shipping and returns
details.body: Express shipping across India. Easy replacement if the product arrives damaged or incorrect.
